mechanism: Indomethacin (NSAID) may reduce the antihypertensive and antiglaucoma efficacy of timolol by inhibiting prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation and increasing systemic absorption of topical timolol.
action: Monitor intraocular pressure and blood pressure closely; consider alternative analgesic/anti-inflammatory agent if possible, or use lowest effective indomethacin dose with frequent IOP monitoring.
